verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रतिज्ञाते तु पार्थेन सिन्धुराजवधे तदा।  वासुदेवो महाबाहुर्धनञ्जयमभाषत ॥१॥
भ्रातॄणां मतमज्ञाय त्वया चाचा प्रतिश्रुतम्।  सैन्धवं चास्मि हन्तेति तत्साहसमिदं कृतम् ॥२॥
असंमन्त्र्य मया सार्धमतिभारोऽयमुद्यतः।  कथं तु सर्वलोकस्य नावहास्या भवेमहि ॥३॥
verses.english: Without taking my advice previously, you have drawn down a heavy burden on your shoulders. Alas! how now shall we escape from being the butt of redicule of all men.

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शिबिरे मया प्रणिहिताश्चराः।  त इमे शीघ्रमागम्य प्रवृत्तिं वेदयन्ति नः ॥४॥
त्वया वै संप्रतिज्ञाते सिन्धुराजवधे प्रभा।  सिंहनादः सवादित्रः सुमहानिह तैः श्रुतः ॥५॥
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता धार्तराष्ट्राः ससैन्धवाः।  नाकस्मात् सिंह‌नादोऽयमिति मत्वा व्यवस्थिताः ॥६॥
verses.english: Terrified at that up-roar, the sons of Dhritarashtra together with all their relatives me and kinsmen, thought-these shouts are not without due causes' and they then waited (for what would ensue next).

verses.sanskrit: सुमहाञ्शब्दसंपातः कौरवाणां महाभुज। आसीन्नागाश्वपत्तीनां रथघोषश्च भैरवः ॥७॥
अभिमन्योर्वधं श्रुत्वा ध्रुवमार्तो धनञ्जयः।  रार्त्रौ निर्यास्यति कोधादिति मत्वा व्यवस्थिताः ॥८॥
verses.english: 'Having been appraised of the slaughter of Abhimanyu, Dhananjaya sorely distressed will surely, in wrath, come out in the night desirous of battle.' Thinking even in the above manner, they stood prepared for battle.

verses.sanskrit: तैर्यतद्भिरियं सत्या श्रुता सत्यवतस्तव।  प्रतिज्ञा सिन्धुराजस्य वधे राजीवलोचन ॥९॥
verses.english: Thus when those vow-observing heroes were preparing for the battle, O you of eyes like lotus petals, they heard of the true vow you had taken for the slaughter of the Sindhu king.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विमनसः सर्वे त्रस्ताः क्षुद्रमृगा इव।  आसन्सुयोधनामात्याः स च राजा जयद्रथः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Thereat the counsellors of Suyodhana all became depressed at heart and they then resembled weak animals struck with panic. Then king Jayadratha,

verses.sanskrit: अथोत्थाय सहामात्यैर्दीनः शिबिरमात्मनः।  आयात्सौवीरसिन्धूनामीश्वरो भृशदुःखितः ॥११॥
स मन्त्रकाले संमन्त्र्य सर्वां नैःश्रेयसीं कियाम्। सुयोधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्राजसंसदि ॥१२॥
verses.english: Then in that time suitable for consultations, he consulted with them about the best remedial measure (against Arjuna's vow). And then repairing to the assembly of kings he said these words to Suyodhana.

verses.sanskrit: मामसौ पुत्र हन्तेति श्वोऽभियाता धनञ्जयः। प्रतिज्ञातो हि सेनाया मध्ये तेन वधो मम ॥१३॥
तां न देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरोरगराक्षसाः।  उत्सहन्तेऽन्यथा कर्तुं प्रतिज्ञां सव्यसाचिनः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Neither the Gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Asuras, nor the reptiles nor the Rakshasas would venture to baffle that Vow of Savyasachin (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit: ते मां रक्षत संग्रामे मा वो मूर्ध्नि धनञ्जयः।  पदं कृत्वाऽप्नुयाल्लक्ष्यं तस्मादत्र विधीयताम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Do you all therefore protect me in battle. Let not Dhananjaya, placing his feet on your heads, succeeded in hitting his target. Let suitable arrangements be made.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रक्षा न मे संख्ये क्रियते कुरुनन्दन।  अनुजानीहि मां राजन् गमिष्यामि गृहान् प्रति ॥१६॥
verses.english: On the other hand, O delighter of the Kurus, if you do not undertake to protect me in battle, permit me, O king, to go back to my home.”

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्त्ववाक्शीर्षो विमनाः स सुयोधनः। श्रुत्वा तं समयं तस्य ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत ॥१७॥
तमार्तमभिसंप्रेक्ष्य राजा किल स सैन्धवः।  मृदु चात्महितं चैव सापेक्षमिदमुक्तवान् ॥१८॥
नेह पश्यामि भवतां तथावीर्यं धनुर्धरम्।  योऽर्जुनस्यास्रमस्त्रेण प्रतिहन्यान्महाहवे ॥१९॥
verses.english: "I do not find any bowman among you who is equal to Arjuna in prowess and who is capable of baffling the weapons of Arjuna in battle, with those of his own.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवसहायस्य गाण्डीवं धुन्वतो धनुः।  कोऽर्जुनस्याग्रतस्तिष्ठेत्साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः ॥२०॥
verses.english: What person would dare stand before Arjuna who is supported by the son of Vasudeva and who wields the Gandiva bow? Even Indra of hundred sacrifices will not venture to do so!

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरोऽपि पार्थेन श्रूयते योधितः पुरा।  पदातिना महावीर्यो गिरौ हिमवति प्रभुः ॥२१॥
verses.english: It is said that the son of Pritha (Arjuna), on foot, fought with Almighty Mahesvara himself in days gone by, on the Himavat mountains.

verses.sanskrit: दानवानां सहस्राणि हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम्।  जघानैकरथेनेव देवराजप्रचोदितः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Being commissioned by the lord of the celestials, he slew on a single chariot thousands of Danavas inhabiting the golden city.

verses.sanskrit: समायुक्तो हि कौन्तेयो वासुदेवेन धीमता।  सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीन् हन्यादिति मतिर्मम ॥२३॥
verses.english: That son of Kunti is now united with the intelligent son of Vasudeva. And I think that he is now competent to destroy the triune, world, with even the immortals therein!

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहमिच्छाम्यनुज्ञातुं रक्षितुं वा महात्मना।  द्रोणेन सहपुत्रेण वीरेण यदि मन्यसे ॥२४॥
verses.english: So, may it please you, I desire to have either your permission to go home or to be protected by the high-souled Drona and his son, both endued with heroism."

verses.sanskrit: स राज्ञा स्वयमाचार्यो भृशमत्रार्थितोऽर्जुन।  संविधानं च विहितं रथाश्च किल सज्जिताः ॥२५॥
verses.english: O Arjuna, thus addressed the king himself entreated the preceptor to undertake to protect Jayadratha. All remedial measures have been adopted; and chariots and steeds have been duly arranged.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णो भूरिश्रवा द्रौणिर्वृषसेनश्च दुर्जयः।  कृपश्च मद्रराजश्च षडेतेऽस्य पुरोगमाः ॥२६॥
शकटः पद्मकश्चार्धो व्यूहो द्रोणेन निर्मितः।  पद्मकर्णिकमध्यस्थः सूची पार्श्वे जयद्रथः ॥२७॥
स्थास्यते रक्षितो वीरैः सिन्धुराट् स सुदुर्मदः। धनुष्यस्त्रे च वीर्ये च प्राणे चैव तथौरसे ॥२८॥
verses.english: There will the invincible king of the Sindhus stand, being protected by those heroes. In handling the bow and other weapons, in prowess, in might and in their high extraction.
verses.bhavadeepa: पद्मव्यूहः पश्चार्धे पश्चाद्भागे यस्य सूची सूचीमुखो व्यूहः ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: अविषह्यतमा ह्येते निश्चिताः पार्थ षड्रथाः।  एतानजित्वा षड्रथान्नैव प्राप्यो जयद्रथः॥२९॥
verses.english: These six warriors, O Partha, are surely exceedingly difficult of being borne down, Without first vanquishing these six carwarriors, you cannot hope to reach Jayadratha.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेकैकशो वीर्यं षण्णां त्वमनुचिन्तय।  सहिता हि नरव्याघ्र न शक्या जेतुमञ्जसा ॥३०॥
verses.english: Think of the respective prowess of these six warriors. O foremost of men, when united together, they cannot be easily defeated.

verses.sanskrit: भूयस्तु मन्त्रयिष्यामि नीतिमात्महिताय वै।  मन्त्रज्ञैः सचिवैः सार्धं सुहृद्भिः कार्यसिद्धये ॥३१॥
